note: THE FIRST GRADABLE SOURCE. Its board was captured in discover run 92448519432 on 2026-09-07 and is committed verbatim as fixtures/gradable-poet-bigstonecity.json; lib/adapters/gradable.mjs reads it to five rows, all five reconciling cash - basis = futures under floor-cent, and test/gradable.test.mjs runs that whole path. locationId is the market id from their own URL. lat, lon, zip and address are copied from POET's bootstrap payload, where the coordinate is their geocoder's, recorded under geocodes["Google/Address"] -- nothing was looked up or derived here. cashRounding is floor-cent because their board says cash_bid_rounding_mode "always_down" on every row, not because anybody counted residuals. bands carries corn alone: corn is the only crop this market's board returned, and a crop it posts later will be withheld loudly rather than published under a band nobody set.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the feed their own market page asks for. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
